parameters.help_en: The name of the Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the Intra-zone Provider First feature
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启同可用区优先
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: This parameter is reserved and not in use
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en: The threshold for the Intra-zone Provider First feature to take effect. If the percentage of instances of the application that are deployed in a zone exceeds the specified threshold, the Intra-zone Provider First feature is enabled for the zone. This indicates that when a consumer initiates a request to the application, the request is preferentially routed to an instance in the same zone as the consumer
parameters.help_zh: 同可用区优先生效阈值。当前应用在某个可用区部署的实例占比超过此阈值时，才会开启该可用区的同可用区优先路由功能。即Consumer向该应用发起请求时，会优先将请求路由到与Consumer同一个可用区的实例上
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The language in which the returned results are displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
